main_topics: Overcoming Barriers to Entry on TikTok

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents feel invisible in crowded online spaces.
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Use TikTok, where only 15% of agents are active, to gain visibility and build trust locally.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents believe their clients aren't on TikTok.
problems_addressed.solution_summary: TikTok's audience includes 100 million daily users, with a growing adult demographic.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents are hesitant to post due to fear of low engagement.
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on consistency and local content; the algorithm rewards regular posting.

episode_summary: This episode introduces the 'Empty Stage Method' for real estate agents to leverage TikTok's low competition and large audience. By focusing on local content and consistent posting, agents can build a trusted presence in their communities. The discussion challenges common misconceptions about TikTok's audience and emphasizes the importance of being an early adopter on the platform.
